title: Linear Two Oh Two
style: 96 bpm neo funk R&B, Soul, Pop, Funk, Jazz, Motown energy clavinet electric piano full horn section tight drum break fretless bass male soul lead with female gospel funk harmonies joyful disciplined groove
lyrics:
[Intro - clavinet riff, brass swell, funky drummer break]
Linear two oh two!
The tickets all in view!
Notion Hub holding the lore
The operator opens the door

[Verse 1 - Male Soul Lead]
Woke up Monday, opened up the board
Linear two oh two, every ticket scored
Three in flight, four in review
Notion Hub got the docs to back what we do
No guess, no maybe, no wishful spin
Just the cycle moving from where we begin
ORICO humming, eight sites breathing slow
The workflow's a rhythm and the rhythm gotta flow

[Pre-Chorus - female harmony, gospel-funk]
So we close it, we ship it, we mark it done
We don't carry it past the setting sun
Linear two oh two keeps the score true
Notion Hub is the memory of what we do

[Chorus - Stevie energy, full horns]
Linear two oh two!
Every cycle coming through!
Notion Hub on the wall
Keeping the names of every call
Linear two oh two!
The operator follows through!
Three thirty six on the brass
The workflow ain't gonna pass

[Verse 2 - Male Lead, deeper groove]
No lost ticket, no orphan task
If it ain't in Linear, the question gets to ask
Is it real, is it scoped, is it owned by name
The doc in Notion Hub remembers the same
No bot decides, no machine commits
The operator types, the operator submits
Family in the Pelican, family in La Banda
Family in the workflow, family in the manda

[Bridge - clavinet solo, brass stabs]
Tickets and docs, docs and tickets
The operator at the wheel, the workflow's wickets
No Keel rank, no commander pose
Just the discipline of finishing what the operator chose

[Final Chorus - big horns, full band]
Linear two oh two!
Every cycle pushing through!
Notion Hub on the wall
Family of every call
Linear two oh two!
The operator types it true!
Three thirty six on the brass
The workflow's a glass we don't pass

[Outro - clavinet fade, brass holding]
Linear... two oh two...
Notion Hub... carrying through...
Three thirty six... the cycle close
The operator types... and the workflow flows.
